en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large multi‑storey hospital complex in a rural valley with forested hills and patchwork fields in the background. The main building has a central tower-like section with vertical windows and long wings extending on both sides. Small houses and garden plots dot the hillside behind it. At the bottom margin there is a white printed caption identifying the location.
